usage: The word 儲物房 (cyu5 mat6 fong2) is used as a noun to refer to a storage room.
It can be used to talk about a specific room in a house or building where items are kept.
You can say '我哋嘅屋企有一個儲物房' (Our home has a storage room) to describe a feature of the house.
儲物房 can describe any small room dedicated to storing things or extra stuff.
It is often used when discussing the layout or organization of a home.

examples.meaning: I put my luggage in the storage room.

examples.sentence: 呢個儲物房啱啱整理好晒。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 cyu5 mat6 fong2 ngam1 ngam1 zing2 lei5 hou2 saai3.

examples.jyutping: cyu5 mat6 fong2 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 gau6 gaa1 si1.
examples.meaning: There are a lot of old furniture in the storage room.

examples.sentence: 你可以喺儲物房拎返啲工具。
examples.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 cyu5 mat6 fong2 ling1 faan1 di1 gung1 geoi6.
